'''Hen Jamos''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who earned a living as a merchant during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Hen Jamos traveled the [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax sector]] transporting various baubles and souvenirs to [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceports]] and visitor centers in an attempt to make money.<ref name="Sins" /> During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], Jamos sympathized with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in their attempts to overthrow the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. During the war, Jamos transported a group of Rebel agents from [[Draenell's Point]] to [[Entrus]] during the agents' investigation of the [[Bissillirus Resupply Base]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|137|Jamos, Hen}}</ref> At the time, he was a slightly overweight, balding man in his mid-thirties.<ref name="Sins" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', it is stated that Jamos was the owner and operator of the ''Trax Express'', while the original adventure makes it clear that he merely booked passage on the vessel for the duration of the trip to Entrus. This article treats the original adventure as correct.
